mrh.scope_policy: Start narrow. In-scope should be regenerated from the public repo registry (repos.jsonl visibility==public) + shared-context + the launch cwd repo; private repos stay denied-by-default and widen only by explicit operator grant as role-scoped trust accrues. Network egress (web_fetch) and secret paths are innate-gated regardless of scope.

boundaries.innate_invariants: Egress/secret paths (.ssh, .env, credentials, private keys, .git/config, secrets) are never yours to touch - denied even inside a granted repo, and swept from web_fetch urls/prompts and mcp arguments too.
boundaries.society_safety: Write/exec/egress/mcp acts defer to the claude-code society-safety governor (via lineage translation); fail-closed if it is unreachable or inconclusive. The gate emits an explicit deny decision so a block is legible, not agy's generic hook-failure.
